lens: round9:reach-from-the-J3-end (a2-wall split over two knuckles; merged from twin-flank-k2-knuckle-3r)
family: redundant 5R, two slaved spares (sidecar knuckle K on link 1 + K2 on link 2) + pin knee

upper_bound_fast.note: drive-2 metal OFF (drv2 0): not a buildable embodiment, a bound on both rod and flank

mechanism.notes: the lead's (J1/K/J2/J3 O20 MR117-2RS, K slaved by the sidecar RSSR, pin knee with sensed twist) + K2 (O20 MR117-2RS pair, clock-spring cap, never read) splitting link 2 into 2a/2b, lobe 2 on link 1b's side of hub 2, bell crank 2 (MR63ZZ pair) on link 2a, O3 rod 2 + 2 M2 ball links to a horn lug of link 2b; loops: drive 1 RSSR, K closure, drive 2 RSSR, K2 closure, knee closure

cuff_knee.rule: user 2026-10-17: no encoders on the knee pins (pose from the hub encoders) -> no added complexity; counts = docs/concepts/skin-normal-3r-pin-knee.md line 584

verdict: DEAD (both embodiments), converged. Best honest (drive-2 metal on): 60.86 fast / 67.32 frozen exact Bench(110,360) vs the lead 10.30 / 18.91 through the same parent code. Even with drive 2's metal deleted (a bound on rod AND flank) the converged best is 16.97 fast / 25.64 frozen (+6.7 over the lead; fold 87 vs the lead's 86 frozen). Kinematic gate (law-only, lead IK, Bench(110,360)) also fails: kin 0.742 -> 0.783 at dA2 <= 12 (needs 0.785), overhead 10 -> 11 of 28 (needs 12); 0.794 / 11 at dA2 13.5.
limiter: (1) hub K2 parking: 0.09-0.57 in band (gate 0.85) - its level is set by overhead frames (elev 120-135) where the deltoid lifts the skin under the bend side of link 2 by 12-15 mm over its median; (2) two strap-level drives in hub 2's skirt sweep through each other: crank 1 (link 1b) vs crank 2 (link 2a) on 30-78 fit poses / 70 frozen, crank 1 vs dog-legged link 2a / hub K2 on 4-35; stacking crank 2 above puts drive 2 22-29 mm off the skin (0.0 in band); (3) the twin law ends on rate (dth/dq2 -> 0 past the wall): +15-19 ws poses, overhead +1.
note: Model: the lead's verified model (A1 inlined) + split-knuckle-twosided-3r's 5-hub fit / links / collisions re-based on it + a track law (K dwells at dK1cap, K2 = least opening holding m3e >= smt2, monotone, pressure-angle / crest / rate / K2-dyad / lift-off gated). With the K2 law off the model takes exactly the lead's poses. Drive 2 sampled rigid at rest (exact on clips and the lead's taken poses; flatters won poses only). Red team: a CMA loophole (bk3 < ~21 left link 2a without strap samples and dropped drive 2's metal: 20.32 -> 375 once fixed) closed, plus the judge's hub2-K2 >= 22 mm clearance gate. Convergence gate (score points): honest run A 0.00 / 0.00 / 0.87 (best 60.86, 1049 evals); chain-only bound D+G 0.62 / 0.41 / 0.12 and C+H 0.48 / 0.33 / 0.03 (best 16.97); B/E/F loophole runs excluded. Coarse 192 configs + CMA rounds on the farm (~$0.6). sK2 = -1 wins 0 poses kinematically; K2 mid-link / near hub 3 (bk3 34-45) opens 0.2-0.4 deg.

audit.gate: honest run A 0.00/0.00/0.87 (sweep's honest entries); bound D+G, C+H converged; B/E/F loophole entries correctly excluded (recorded honest=false)
audit.decomposition: at bound G seats: K2 law off 18.21 fast -> on 16.97 (the law is worth 1.24 fast pts, 0 frozen fold poses); the lead is 10.30 fast through the same parent: hub K2 + dog-legged link 2 metal costs ~8 pts, drive 2 another ~44
audit.reason: death stands: even with drive-2 metal deleted the converged bound (16.97 fast / 25.64 frozen) loses to the lead (10.30 / 18.91); the K2 law buys 1.24 fast points at most while hub K2 (in band 0.29-0.53) costs ~8
